G1. Memory-bounded MAS vs quantized monolith
Addressed for ≤16 GB on financial numerical QA and synthetic KYC/credit; 32 GB not run.
Addressed by identical tools, packets, executor and gate, and by improving both arms in the same way. Adapter optimization at 16 GB was not possible (pretrained only).
G3. QLoRA hardening vs verifier gate

Partially addressed at 8 GB. On development questions, adaptation and trained critics added correct deliveries but also wrong ones (3B actor: 0/0/24 → 10/11/3 C/W/H; critic: C 3 → 11, W 0 → 4). The crossed critic passed the no-loss rule against its matched control but failed it against the original critic and on the reserved audit, so it was not adopted.

Partially addressed. C/W/H, coverage and dual numerical conventions are reported. Planted-mismatch recall and refusal correctness were 0 for both arms at 8 GB, and the invention metric partly measures output-contract compliance (Section 7.5).
